sampling_statement: One newly executed rollout per initial configuration and condition; unweighted descriptive diagnostic, NOT a fresh run for each seed or an independent sample expansion.
intervention_operation: negate_current_output at every step from the selected onset; not a fixed counterfactual value and not a truth-labelled flip
postprocessing_note: Descriptive cohort summaries recomputed from unchanged recorded rollouts using v9 code_changes evaluator; sampling intervals suppressed because this is a finite four-configuration diagnostic.
